title: Jeju City, JJD — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]

content:
Overview

Jeju City is a city in JJD with a population of 500,000. The largest city on Jeju Island, a volcanic paradise known for its stunning coastline, Hallasan Mountain, and unique culture. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
